description: This file defines a FastAPI router for handling evidence package retrieval and verification endpoints. It includes route definition for fetching an evidence package by ID with integrity checks, interacting with database services, and handling related errors.

classes.name: EvidencePackageResponse
classes.description: Response schema for an evidence package, including identifiers, artifacts, and metadata.

classes.name: EvidenceArtifact
classes.description: Schema representing individual evidence artifacts with type, ID, hash, and storage reference.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: Schema for error responses returned by API endpoints.

methods.name: EvidencePackageResponse get_evidence_package( evidence_package_id: str, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security), )
methods.description: Asynchronous endpoint function to retrieve an evidence package by ID with integrity verification, handling errors and constructing the response.
